description: Renders a list of in-progress and finished uploads with progress bars and cancel / resume / dismiss actions.

parameters.name: Uploads
parameters.description: Uploads to display (in-progress and recently finished).

parameters.name: OnCancel
parameters.description: Invoked when the user cancels an in-flight upload.

parameters.name: OnResume
parameters.description: Invoked when the user resumes a cancelled or failed upload.

parameters.name: OnDismiss
parameters.description: Invoked when the user dismisses a finished upload from the list.
